context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 69 verified the SOL price fix. The sync-positions endpoint now correctly uses Jupiter price API (~$86) instead of the buggy value ($0.019). All 4 positions (RNDR, one, LNG, WRT) have correct invested SOL amounts: ~0.003 SOL each for synced positions, 0.01 SOL for RNDR. Total invested SOL is ~0.02 SOL (was ~87 SOL before fix).

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The sync-positions endpoint was using an incorrect SOL price ($0.019 instead of ~$140) when calculating the invested SOL amount for synced positions. This resulted in wildly inflated amount_sol values (~29 SOL instead of ~0.003 SOL).
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added Jupiter price API (https://price.jup.ag/v6/price?ids=SOL) as primary source with CoinGecko fallback and $140 ultimate fallback. Added sanity check to ensure SOL price is between $50-$500.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All 4 positions now show correct invested SOL amounts. Total invested SOL is ~0.02 SOL (expected) instead of ~87 SOL (bug).
